questions.question: What is the error code for Zhā Qiāng (Spear Thrust)?
What are the deduction points for Zhā Qiāng (Spear Thrust)?
questions.answer: Deductions are applied when: 1) Spear head not travelling in a clearly defined arc, 2) Rear handle of spear end protrudes from the grip, 3) The thrusting arm and spear shaft do not form a horizontal straight line.
choices: Deductions are applied when: 1) The back of the broadsword blade is not kept close to the body when wrapping or twining.
Deductions are applied when: 1) Raised shank/calf of the leg is not turning obliquely inwards, and 2) Raised foot's toes are not pointed and hooking inwards.
Deductions are applied when: 1) Straight sword and forearm or wrist are aligned, 2) No obvious vertical circle formed.
